title: Mixer capability guest release protocol v3

canonicalization.map_order: bytewise lexicographic order of encoded keys
canonicalization.data_model: text keys and values, unsigned integers, arrays, maps and booleans; all declared struct fields included, no nulls or omitted fields
canonicalization.artifact_signature: Ed25519(mixer.artifact.v3 followed by one NUL byte followed by canonical CBOR manifest)
canonicalization.assignment_signature: Ed25519(mixer.assignment.v3 followed by one NUL byte followed by canonical CBOR assignment)
canonicalization.artifact_identity: lowercase SHA256 hex of canonical CBOR manifest
canonicalization.signature_transport: RFC4648 canonical padded standard base64 text encoding exactly 64 bytes; numeric arrays, CR/LF, nonzero pad bits and missing padding reject

negotiation: Explicit installed identity2; registered host and manifest schema/protocol3, guestABI2/UI1; assignment schema3. Capability route and exact execution contract fixed by identity; no ranges, probing, implicit upgrade/downgrade or release-selected import policy. Old v1/v2 validation and signature bytes remain unchanged.

manifest_fields.runtime: 64 lowercase hex exact installed runtime fingerprint
manifest_fields.capability_hashes: explicit map of zero..two known schema ids to exact hashes; exactly equal immutable installed identity map
manifest_fields.compressed_bytes: unsigned integer1..min(installed identity maximum4194304, unchanged wire safety limit16777216)
manifest_fields.expanded_bytes: exactly compressed_bytes, no compression; same limits
manifest_fields.asset_hashes: empty map only; separate assets fail closed until verified extraction exists
manifest_fields.source_map_sha256: 64 lowercase hex reference only, not executed/fetched by this contract
manifest_fields.created_at_unix: positive uint64 audit time, not replay authority

capability_grants.entries: 0..2 closed grant entries; every array explicit, strictly sorted unique ASCII, and every present entry binds its signed capability_hashes schema hash

assignment_fields.sequence: positive uint64 monotonically increasing within app/environment/platform/runtime/channel

capability_grant_descriptor.entry_order: strict ascending ASCII capability_id; reject duplicates
capability_grant_descriptor.set_order: strict ascending ASCII strings; reject duplicates before set conversion
capability_grant_descriptor.missing_entry: deny; installed schema hash alone grants no authority
capability_grant_descriptor.binding: each present entry equals its signed capability_hashes entry and the known schema hash

origins.host_rule: lowercase DNS labels a-z 0-9 hyphen; nonempty labels; no leading or trailing hyphen
origins.port_rule: absent or canonical decimal 1..65535 excluding 443; no leading zeros

storage.keyValue.v1.namespace_rule: case-sensitive ASCII A-Z a-z 0-9 underscore hyphen; length 1..64

capability_grant_descriptor_hash: lowercase SHA256 of RFC8949 core deterministic CBOR of capability_grant_descriptor; bytewise encoded-key ordering; descriptor hash excludes this parent document

capability_grant_entry_fields.capability_id: known capability identifier, unique entry strictly sorted by ASCII
capability_grant_entry_fields.schema_sha256: exact known schema hash and matching signed capability_hashes entry
capability_grant_entry_fields.permissions: explicit strictly sorted unique ASCII array; empty denies; subset of the family permission
capability_grant_entry_fields.origins: explicit strictly sorted unique ASCII array; HTTP exact canonical origins only; empty denies HTTP
capability_grant_entry_fields.methods: explicit strictly sorted unique ASCII array; HTTP allowed method names only; empty denies HTTP
capability_grant_entry_fields.namespaces: explicit strictly sorted unique ASCII array; storage exact identifiers only; empty denies storage

authority: These definitions alone enable no runtime, effects, release or publication. Execution requires an implementing trusted installed binary, matching immutable identity/material, verified signed selection and all specified gates. Proposal/implementation/qualification status is tracked outside these byte-hashed files.
native_fingerprint: Installed runtime fingerprint must additionally cover installed grants/configuration, generated bridge and native implementation, compiler/toolchain/platform, dependencies, permissions and custom HTTP implementation. This protocol does not generate or attest that fingerprint.
identifier: 1..128 ASCII letters, numbers, dot, underscore or hyphen
cohort: SHA256 of canonical CBOR map {organization,project,app,environment,channel,installation}; treat digest as unsigned big-endian integer modulo 10000; eligible if less than signed rollout_basis_points. Stable expansion; installation ID is app-private random pseudonym, never account/customer data. Reinstallation generates new ID; account switching retains ID.
trust: same pinned Ed25519 root roles/scope/validity and strict canonical signatures; no new signing/root/delegation authority. Retained-healthy offline exception applies only to exact previously committed compatible healthy records via private recovery selection; never relaxed verification of newly offered/staged content.

http.routes: same explicit route suffixes/RBAC/request bounds as frozen v1/v2; only separate strict v3 typed wire objects
http.selection: route3, schema/protocol3, registered host3/ABI2/UI1 and exact scope/runtime all agree; no failed-verification fallback; wrong-version offers204/artifacts404, mutations reject
http.channels: same app/environment/platform/runtime/channel high-water namespace; old runtime heads retained; rollback requires fresh greater sequence
http.storage: local schema3 only on first successful v3 write; preserve valid1/2 reads and exact prior signed/audit/response bytes; failed calls do not upgrade; older readers refuse3
http.idempotency: versioned method/path/exactbody bind tenant request; cross-version same-key conflicts; no re-sign or normalize historic bytes
http.postgres: strict schema3 dispatch over existing opaque signed bytes; do not assume SQL migration unnecessary without independent review
http.definition_only: Route/storage semantics require their own implementing service and qualification; this contract does not enable a server or publication.

contract_format: bounded protocol reference with closed structural schemas; lexical, cross-field, full executable and authority checks remain mandatory; JSON Schema alone never authorizes execution

wire_types.unknown_optional_fields: none; reject unknown/missing/duplicate decoded keys at every nested object
wire_types.numbers: canonical unsigned base10 UInt64 integer tokens only; no signs, decimal/exponent, strings or bool coercion; then field bounds
wire_types.limits: all positive; each<=installed identity; memory and payload<=4194304, fuel<=1000000,startup<=60000; effective pages floor(min signed/installed bytes /65536), never round upward

execution_binding.downloaded_execution_selector: none; exact runtime fingerprint already binds identity route/material/native/bridge/ceilings
execution_binding.verified_token: only signature+scope+payload verified artifact exposes opaque grants/limits; assignment eligibility additionally required for cold-start selection; public models/DTOs/sidecars confer none
execution_binding.effective_permissions: independent intersection of installed and verified signed permission/origin/method/namespace sets; unknown/missing/empty deny; compatibility hashes never grant
execution_binding.capability_limits: installed-only N/reservation/timeout/turn/rate; release cannot widen/select them; signed base limits only narrow
execution_binding.unsupported: assets, compression, delegation, new capabilities/WASI/native code, arbitrary plugins or graph discovery fail closed
execution_binding.zero_page_effective_limit: positive signed/installed bytes may floor to0pages; exact0 support preferred via reviewed bridge change; if unavailable reject before staging, never round up1

preservation.grant_descriptor: exact existing schema1 object and hash unchanged
preservation.old_verifier_apis: keep strict protocol1/2 and guestABI1; new v3 context/type explicitly selected once

qualification_boundary: Contract bytes are not proof of implementation, validation, native I/O, actual health, full Swift/UI/FieldLog, complete build graph/consumption/embedding, published packaging, physical lifecycle/performance, signing/store/hosted/GA qualification. Those require separate accountable evidence.
